# Format: "<tick> <hashHex8>" per line — tick decimal, hash 8 uppercase hex digits (no 0x).
# checksum_algo_version: 7
# Pins the SimChecksum (v6) sequence for ModifierScenario.Build() (four stationary P1 units driven through a fixed apply/refresh/stack/ignore/DoT/HoT/Energy schedule; Player2 empty so the AI no-ops) stepped via StepOnce at ChecksumInterval=1. First golden with ACTIVE ModifierStore state. All hashed fields are integer/Fixed → byte-identical Win↔Linux; NOT Windows-gated, compared on both CI legs.
# Samples: 300 (one line per sim tick).
